title: A deep copy and compare
description:
Copy nested tables properly and compare them by value.

```
copy is a different table: true
changing the copy leaves the original: 3
equal(original, copy): true
equal after change: false
```

starter.main.lua:
local function deep_copy(t, seen)
  return t
end

local function equal(a, b)
  return a == b
end

local original = { name = "Ada", stats = { hp = 3, mp = 5 }, items = { "sword", "map" } }
local copy = deep_copy(original)
print("copy is a different table:", copy ~= original)

hints: `seen = seen or {}` and `if seen[t] then return seen[t] end` before copying stops repeated tables being copied twice (lesson 2.05).
`equal` first checks `type(a) == "table" and type(b) == "table"`, then every key of `a` in `b`, and every key of `b` in `a`.
requirements: `deep_copy(t)` copies nested tables; values that are not tables are copied as they are.
`equal(a, b)` compares nested tables key by key (both directions).
Handle a table that appears twice in the same structure (copy it once).
